ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; high-intensity pixels are restricted to the distal tips, representing approximately 5% of the visible surface, while >95% of the fluke body is composed of low-intensity dark pixels.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: White pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization or scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent bilateral depigmentation and scarring localized exclusively to the distal tips of the fluke lobes.
